payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons between those who received personalised and non-personalised texts, particularly regarding completion rates and time to respond.

claims.text: Those who received non-personalised text messages had a higher completion rate (66.0% for non-personalised late) compared to those who received personalised text messages (50.0% for personalised early).

There was a slight difference in the average time to completion, with personalised texts averaging 8.2 days for early and 7.1 days for late, while non-personalised texts averaged 4.9 days for early and 4.7 days for late.
